Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Present on Dashboard
Description: Verify that a new tile named "Processing status" (Bearbeitungsstatus) is added to the dashboard
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and has access to dashboard

Expected Result: A tile named "Processing status" (Bearbeitungsstatus) is present on the dashboard

Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Displays All Action Statuses
Description: Verify that the tile displays statuses of actions: saved - for approval - and approved
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and Processing status tile is visible on dashboard. Records exist in saved - for approval - and approved statuses
Expected Result: Dashboard page loads with Processing status tile visible

Step Description: Observe the Processing status tile content for saved status
Expected Result: Tile displays saved status (indicated by save icon per Tributum context)

Step Description: Observe the Processing status tile content for approval status
Expected Result: Tile displays for approval status (indicated by single orange tick icon per Tributum context)

Step Description: Observe the Processing status tile content for approved status
Expected Result: Tile displays approved status (indicated by green double tick icon per Tributum context)

Test Case Name: Verify Pop-up Appears When Processing Status Tile is Activated
Description: Verify that when the tile is activated a pop-up appears showing current actions being processed
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and Processing status tile is visible on dashboard

Expected Result: Pop-up displays details of actions currently being processed

Test Case Name: Verify Navigation from Pop-up to Original Mask for Release Process
Description: Verify that users can select an area in the pop-up to navigate to the original mask for continuing the release process
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and Processing status pop-up is open with actions displayed
Step Description: Open the Processing status tile pop-up from dashboard
Expected Result: Pop-up displays with list of actions being processed

Step Description: Identify a selectable area in the pop-up
Expected Result: Selectable areas are present for each action in the pop-up

Step Description: Select (click) an area in the pop-up

Expected Result: User is navigated to the original mask (Bearbeiten page per Tributum context)

Step Description: Verify release process can be continued
Expected Result: User can continue the release process from the original mask
